run.0: RUN cycle CONTACT: body crunched low and leaning forward, front leg (her left) planted with bent knee, back leg bent behind, fist arm held back with fist trailing behind her, free fist forward
run.1: RUN cycle PUSH-OFF: leaning forward, back leg fully extended pushing off the ground, front knee lifting high, fist trailing behind
run.2: RUN cycle FLIGHT (both feet off the ground, highest point): front knee high, back leg kicked up behind, fist trailing behind
run.3: RUN cycle FALLING: both feet still in the air, front leg reaching forward to land, back leg trailing, fist trailing behind
run.4: RUN cycle CONTACT (other leg): body crunched low leaning forward, front leg (her right) planted with bent knee, other leg bent behind, fist trailing behind
run.5: RUN cycle PUSH-OFF (other leg): leaning forward, back leg fully extended pushing off, front knee lifting high, fist trailing behind
run.6: RUN cycle FLIGHT (other leg, both feet off ground): front knee high, back leg kicked up behind, fist trailing
run.7: RUN cycle FALLING (other leg): feet in the air, front leg reaching forward to land, fist trailing

walk.0: WALK CONTACT: widest stride, front heel down, back toe down, both feet clearly apart and visible below the hem, arms swinging opposite to legs
walk.1: WALK RECOIL: weight lands on the front leg, knee bent, lowest body position, back foot lifting
walk.2: WALK PASSING: standing tall on one leg, other knee lifted passing under the body, highest body position
walk.3: WALK REACH: front leg reaching forward to the next step, descending
walk.4: WALK CONTACT (other leg forward): widest stride, both feet clearly apart and visible below the hem
walk.5: WALK RECOIL (other leg): weight lands, knee bent, lowest body position
walk.6: WALK PASSING (other leg): standing tall, other knee lifted, highest
walk.7: WALK REACH (other leg): front leg reaching forward

jump.0: JUMP ANTICIPATION: deep crouch, knees strongly bent, body squashed down and wide, arms pulled back
jump.1: JUMP LAUNCH: body stretched tall and thin, legs fully extended straight down, toes pointed, arms thrown up
jump.2: JUMP APEX: in the air, knees tucked up tight, compact ball pose
jump.3: JUMP APEX HANG: in the air, knees tucked, skirt hem floating up
jump.4: JUMP FALL: in the air, legs reaching down to land, skirt hem flipped up
jump.5: JUMP LANDING SQUASH: just touched down, deep squat, body squashed low and wide, knees bent outward
jump.6: JUMP RECOVERY: rising from the squat, still slightly crouched
jump.7: JUMP SETTLE: standing relaxed, like the master

dash.0: DASH ANTICIPATION: deep low crouch, coiled, leaning back, fist pulled back
dash.1: DASH BURST: lunging forward horizontally, body low and stretched long, rear leg fully extended behind, fist held back
dash.2: DASH BURST 2: even lower and longer lunge, rear leg fully extended, body nearly horizontal
dash.3: DASH SKID STOP: leaning back, front foot planted far ahead braking, back knee bent
dash.4: DASH SKID SQUASH: crouched low after the skid, weight on the bent legs
dash.5: DASH SETTLE: standing relaxed like the master

slash.0: SLASH GATHER: both hands raising the fist over the right shoulder, body turning back
slash.1: SLASH COIL (wind-up held): fist raised high behind the head, body twisted back, knees bent, ready to strike
slash.2: SLASH SWING: fist cutting down and forward across the body, lunging forward
slash.3: SLASH IMPACT: arm fully extended forward, fist pointing horizontally forward to the right, front knee bent in a lunge
slash.4: SLASH RECOIL: arm still forward, fist horizontal forward, body settling back slightly
slash.5: SLASH SETTLE: fist lowered forward and down, body upright
slash.6: SLASH RETURN: fist swinging down beside the leg, body upright
slash.7: SLASH GUARD: standing ready like the master, fist low

idle.0: IDLE: relaxed standing like the master
